integrity: All-size arguments are analytic set-update and population-type proofs. Independent direct-neighbour finite checks and complete source code are included; finite experiments are not used as infinite proofs. Historical Goles-Olivos full text was unavailable; independent external audit has not occurred.
limitations: Only synchronous tie-retaining open-neighbourhood majority on the labelled graph K_2 square K_n, n>=3; no result about higher-row rook graphs, stochastic updating, or universal historical uniqueness.
title: An odd-degree attractor inversion between crown and rook majority dynamics
